experimental_scope: Synthetic Model 3, not natural islands. Policy interventions have exactly matched initial expression and pollen/maternal/paternal reproductive returns; they alter I-locus allele carrier fraction/standing genetic variance. Locus I has no new mutation or immigration.

registered_inference.statistical_independent_axes: 8 founder labels crossed with 8 visitor-history labels, not 64 independent island systems
registered_inference.method: Paired two-way crossed independent resampling of 8 founder labels and 8 visitor-history labels; two-sided Bonferroni 97.5% intervals, familywise >=95%
registered_inference.primary_joint_success_rule: both intervals exclude zero; no new samples/seeds added for inconclusive results

far_within_paired_I_event_transition_cou.interpretation: The net +12/64 difference includes 17 gain and 5 loss paired histories, so increasing carriers was not individually monotonic.

independent_original_archive_readback.audit_type: separate read-only arithmetic + array, pedigree/segregation and SHA256 checks from all 32 original ZIPs, not a second native biological-run replication

scientific_limits: Both registered co-primary intervals include zero; they do not confirm a directional generalized effect of I-carrier density on temporal response ordering or I-event incidence across independent founders and visitor histories.

Reachability of the narrow I support policy is structurally impossible at founder-relative -0.05 given no I mutation/immigration; 0/64 far and 0/64 near are engineered negative controls, not novel independent selection laws.
Even fixed support, dense versus sparse changes allele frequencies, standing genetic variance and population genotype distribution together.
All 384 paths occupied at terminal update 200; this is a demographic ceiling and not a Q4 survival benefit test.
This is not a causal mediator identifying why separate native finite and genotype-density comparisons had 3/32 and 2/32 A-first histories.
All source ZIPs are stored as time-limited GitHub Actions artifacts; no permanent independent DOI-backed raw archive has yet been confirmed.
